caption: Icicles hanging from a roof gutter drip steadily in the afternoon sun.

sa.check: Icicles hang from a roof gutter.
The icicles drip: drops form and leave their tips.
The dripping is steady: more than one drop falls.
Drops gather at the tips rather than along the shafts.

pc.expect: Each drop gathers at an icicle's tip, hangs, and then falls straight down away from it.
pc.fail: A drop climbs the icicle; or leaves the tip sideways with nothing blowing it; or hangs at the tip and draws back into the ice; or a drop travels upward toward the gutter.

pc.expect: The icicles only shorten or thin; they do not build up while they drip.
pc.fail: An icicle lengthens while drops fall from it; or a fallen drop returns and freezes onto the tip; or an icicle thickens; or a drip retreats into the ice.

pc.expect: The icicles are hard ice that stays rigid; they glisten as they melt and may snap off.
pc.fail: An icicle sags or bends like a rope; or flows as a soft lump; or the ice turns to snow all over at once; or an icicle stretches longer as a drop pulls on its tip.

pc.expect: The melt has an effect below: drops land on whatever lies beneath and wet it.
pc.fail: Drops land and leave the ground below dry; or drops vanish in mid-air before landing; or the ground is wet in a place no drop reaches.

pc.expect: The icicles keep their number and stay attached to the gutter until they break away.
pc.fail: An icicle vanishes while still hanging; or a new icicle appears fully formed; or an icicle passes through the gutter; or the gutter changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The roof, the gutter and the look of the ice stay the same.
pc.fail: The gutter changes colour; or the roof tiles change pattern; or the ice turns a colour.
